sector--noun.def: One part of a country's economy or activity.
sector--noun.ex: The tourism sector grew last year.

laser--noun.def: A narrow very strong beam of light.
laser--noun.ex: Surgeons use a laser for this.

lobby--noun.def: The entrance hall of a hotel, or a group that pressures politicians.
lobby--noun.ex: Wait for me in the lobby.

recipe--noun.def: A set of instructions for cooking a dish.

missile--noun.def: A weapon that flies through the air to a target.

tricky--adj.def: Difficult to do because it needs care.

cellar--noun.def: A room under a house used for storage.
cellar--noun.ex: The wine is kept in the cellar.

mortal--adj.def: Certain to die one day, or causing death.

laptop--noun.def: A small computer you can carry and open like a book.

rainbow--noun.def: A curve of colours in the sky after rain.
rainbow--noun.ex: A rainbow appeared over the valley.

mature--adj.def: Fully grown, or behaving in a sensible adult way.
mature--adj.ex: She is very mature for her age.

pirate--noun.def: A person who attacks ships to steal, or who copies work illegally.
pirate--noun.exTr: Korsanlar bir zamanlar bu kıyıyı kontrol ederdi.

retirement--noun.def: The period after you stop working for good.

mill--noun.def: A building where grain is ground, or a factory.

fatal--adj.def: Causing death, or leading to complete failure.

copper--noun.def: A soft reddish metal that carries electricity well.
copper--noun.ex: The pipes are made of copper.

enterprise--noun.def: A business, or a bold new project.
enterprise--noun.ex: The bakery is a family enterprise.

roast--adj.def: Cooked in an oven or over a fire.

scheduled--adj.def: Arranged to happen at a set time.
scheduled--adj.ex: The scheduled flight leaves at six.

donkey--noun.def: A grey animal like a small horse with long ears.

reference--noun.def: A mention of something, or a letter about a worker.
reference--noun.ex: Her old boss wrote a reference.
reference--noun.exTr: Eski patronu bir referans mektubu yazdı.

bully--verb.def: To frighten or hurt someone weaker, again and again.
bully--verb.ex: Nobody should be bullied at school.

collapse--verb.def: To fall down suddenly, or to fail completely.
collapse--verb.ex: The old roof collapsed in the storm.

wealthy--adj.def: Having a lot of money and property.
wealthy--adj.ex: A wealthy family built the school.

disgrace--noun.def: The loss of respect after doing something wrong.

dime--noun.def: An American coin worth ten cents.

domestic--adj.def: Inside one country, or relating to the home.

spite--noun.def: The wish to hurt someone because you feel wronged.
spite--noun.ex: He broke it out of spite.

rebel--noun.def: A person who fights against a government or authority.

rebel--verb.def: To fight against those in power.
rebel--verb.ex: The villagers rebelled against the tax.

encounter--verb.def: To meet someone, or to face a problem unexpectedly.

sigh--verb.def: To let out a long breath showing tiredness or relief.

sister-in-law--noun.def: The sister of your husband or wife.
sister-in-law--noun.ex: My sister in law lives nearby.

dreadful--adj.ex: We had a dreadful journey home.

shrink--noun.def: The amount by which something becomes smaller.
shrink--noun.ex: Allow for shrink when you cut.

shrink--verb.def: To become smaller, especially after washing.
shrink--verb.ex: The shirt shrank in hot water.

proven--adj.def: Shown by evidence to be true or effective.

label--noun.def: A piece of paper on a product giving information.

tan--noun.def: Brown skin colour from the sun.
tan--noun.ex: She came back with a deep tan.

worm--noun.def: A small soft creature with no legs that lives in soil.
worm--noun.ex: A worm moved through the soil.

publicity--noun.def: Public attention given to a person or a product.

exception--noun.def: A case that does not follow the usual rule.

ultimately--adv.def: In the end, after everything else.

compromise--verb.def: To settle an argument by each side giving something up.

dock--noun.def: The place where ships are loaded and repaired.
dock--noun.ex: The ship waited at the dock.

passionate--adj.def: Having or showing very strong feeling.

lawn--noun.def: An area of short cut grass near a house.
lawn--noun.ex: He cuts the lawn on Saturdays.

opponent--noun.def: A person you play or argue against.

convention--noun.def: A usual way of behaving, or a large meeting.

messenger--noun.def: A person who carries a message.

cough--noun.def: A sudden noisy push of air from the throat.

disguise--noun.def: Clothes or a change of appearance that hides who you are.

disguise--verb.def: To change how something looks so it is not recognized.

ballet--noun.def: A formal style of dance telling a story with music.

possessed--adj.def: Controlled by an evil spirit, in stories.
possessed--adj.ex: The villagers thought he was possessed.

harmless--adj.def: Not able to cause any damage.

withdraw--verb.def: To take money out, or to move back from a place.

hint--noun.def: A small clue, or a useful piece of advice.

arrogant--adj.def: Behaving as if you are better than others.

leap--noun.def: A big jump, or a sudden large increase.

proposed--adj.ex: The proposed route crosses the river.

caring--adj.def: Kind and interested in helping others.

bounce--noun.def: The movement of something hitting a surface and coming back.
bounce--noun.ex: Catch the ball on the bounce.

creek--noun.def: A small stream, or a narrow inlet of the sea.

lighting--noun.def: The lamps that light a place, or the light they give.
lighting--noun.ex: The lighting in here is poor.

racist--noun.def: A person who treats others badly because of their race.

gasp--noun.def: A quick breath taken in from surprise or pain.
gasp--noun.ex: A gasp went round the room.

draft--noun.def: An early version of a text before the final one.

factor--noun.def: One of the things that affects a result.

chew--verb.def: To break food with your teeth before swallowing.

carbon--noun.def: A chemical element found in all living things.

memorial--noun.def: A structure built to remember a person or an event.
memorial--noun.ex: They laid flowers at the memorial.

bearing--noun.def: The way something relates to a subject, or a direction.
bearing--noun.ex: That has no bearing on the case.
